winter_inversion_delhi.title: Winter Inversion Episode (Indo-Gangetic Basin)
winter_inversion_delhi.ambient_conditions: Temp: 11°C, Humidity: 85%, Wind: 0.8 m/s, BLH: 45m (Severe Stagnation)
winter_inversion_delhi.scientific_rationale: Compressed planetary boundary layer traps surface particulate emissions within a thin air column, preventing vertical dispersal.

summer_ozone_peak_ahmedabad.title: Pre-Monsoon Photochemical Ozone Surge (Western Corridor)
summer_ozone_peak_ahmedabad.scientific_rationale: High ultraviolet flux drives intense photochemical dissociation of NO2 precursors into reactive oxygen radicals, accelerating ground-level tropospheric ozone formation.

monsoon_washout_kochi.title: Southwest Monsoon Scavenging Event (Malabar Coast)
monsoon_washout_kochi.scientific_rationale: Heavy rainfall raindrops physically scavenge suspended aerosol particles through wet deposition, yielding clean air baselines.
